Elimination journal entries balance revenue against cost per source document.

The balance template needs a bare amount column, but the claim's amount is the expression eliminate_revenue_eur + eliminate_cost_eur. The params also group by journal_id rather than the source_document named in the claim. No bare column or grouping carries the revenue-against-cost balance, so it stays untested.
Employee rates are valid from 2025-01-01 per employee.

employee_rates has only a valid_from column and no valid_to, so validity_join has no interval to test for gaps or overlaps. Whether every valid_from is 2025-01-01 is a constant-value check that no admissible template expresses.
Intercompany sender and receiver amounts should match per transaction.

ic_symmetry needs two distinct sides to relate (e.g. separate sender and receiver ledgers or period columns). Here sender_amount_eur and receiver_amount_eur are two columns of the same ic_transactions view with the same date column, so the template would compare rows to themselves and test nothing. The per-transaction sender/receiver match stays untested.
The VAT rate on sales documents decodes from the issuing entity's country (DE 19%, PL 23%).

range_join tests a value against from/to interval bounds. The claim is a categorical mapping from issuing entity to VAT rate (HVW-DE 0.19, BHW-PL 0.23), and the params give no real range columns, so the template does not fit. A decode-style check would suit it, but decode is not admissible here.
